label: Stelmack 2002
setting: two VA low-vision rehabilitation programs: VICTORS (Chicago Health Care System, West Side Division; partially sighted veterans) and Blind Rehabilitation Center (Hines VA Hospital; legally blind veterans)
diagnosis_mix: VICTORS (n=51): macular degeneration 39.2%; glaucoma 21.6%; diabetic retinopathy 17.6%. BRC (n=77): macular degeneration 66.2%; diabetic retinopathy 15.6%; glaucoma 11.7% (most frequent diagnoses only)
recruitment: consecutive patients admitted to each program; written consent waived by IRB; excluded severe cognitive or hearing deficits; 5 BRC veterans withdrawn and 2 VICTORS veterans died (p7); no masking
notes: Not a diagnostic accuracy study: Rasch analysis of NEI VFQ-25 plus 14-item supplement (39 items administered; 34 analysed after dropping 3 driving items and 2 items on 0-10 scale; p9) before and after rehabilitation, with instructions modified to allow low-vision devices (p8). Country not stated in text; sites named as Chicago IL and Hines IL (p6). Mean age VICTORS 68 (range 44-87), BRC 72 (range 38-88) (p7); age_range is the union of both ranges. pct_female = (11+5)/128 derived from p7 sex counts. pct_glaucoma = (0.216x51 + 0.117x77)/128 = 20/128 derived from p7 percentages. Mean best corrected VA 0.54 logMAR (20/63) VICTORS and 1.00 logMAR (20/200) BRC (p7). Whether the 128 are those left after the 5 withdrawals and 2 deaths is unclear; n_enrolled = n = 128 as stated in Abstract p1 and Subjects p7.
